methods.common_period: months inside the window in which both series have a usable value (value_clean); only those months are used
methods.anomaly: each series minus its own mean of the same calendar month over the common months, so different baselines, absolute values versus anomalies, and degC versus K are comparable; both anomalies and their difference therefore average to zero
methods.trend: least-squares slope of the anomalies on time over the common months, 95% confidence interval and p with the lag-1 autocorrelation correction (trends.ols_trend)
methods.largest_step: for every month m, the mean of the difference over the 6 months from m minus the mean over the 6 months before m (at least 4 months on each side); the month with the largest absolute value
methods.grid_cube_cell: model value of the grid cell that contains the station, read from the global monthly cube; if that cell has no values, the nearest cell with values within 2 cells
methods.annual: calendar-year means of the monthly anomalies and difference; null when fewer than 9 common months

note: A difference between a model and an observation does not by itself say which one is right. Stations are points, model values are grid cells; see docs/data/model-vs-obs.md.

related_not_same_quantity.note: MODIS land surface temperature is the radiometric skin temperature of the surface under clear sky, not the 2 m air temperature; it is not paired with station air temperature or GISTEMP.
AIRS surface air temperature is a satellite retrieval (an observation, not a model), so it is not on the model side; AIRS skin temperature (surfskintemp) is a different quantity from air temperature.
No observation series is available to pair with: SMAP has 0 recommended-quality retrievals over Taiwan (docs/data/sources/smap.md) and there is no evapotranspiration observation in this project.

gldas_tair_step_2011_05.summary_en: Step of about +0.4 K in the global land mean against MERRA-2 (GLDAS minus MERRA-2, 6 months before and after: +0.43 K); the month matches the NCEP GSI/GFS upgrade of 2011-05-09.

gldas_tair_step_2017_07.summary_en: Step of about +0.6 K in the global land mean against MERRA-2 (+0.62 K); the month matches the NEMS GFS upgrade of 2017-07-19.

gldas_tair_step_2019_06.summary_en: Step of about -0.6 K in the global land mean against MERRA-2 (-0.66 K); the month matches the FV3-based GFS v15.1 of 2019-06-12.

station_temp_kaohsiung_airport_sampling.summary_en: Kaohsiung International Airport (TWI0000RCKH): the median number of observations per day rose from about 24 (2001-2005) to 44 (2021-2025). The 2001-2025 trend is 0.465 degC per decade with all observations and 0.334 when only 3-hourly observations are kept; the monthly mean is not corrected for this.

ghcnm_tavg.name_en: Station monthly mean temperature (NOAA GHCNm v4, QCF adjusted)
ghcnm_tavg.data_kind_note: NOAA GHCNm v4 QCF: station monthly mean temperature, quality-controlled and pairwise-homogenized (PHA-adjusted) by NOAA, so not the raw reported value (docs/data/sources/ghcnm.md).

ghcnm_tavg_unadj.name_en: Station monthly mean temperature (NOAA GHCNm v4, QCU unadjusted)
ghcnm_tavg_unadj.data_kind_note: NOAA GHCNm v4 QCU: station monthly mean temperature as reported, quality control only, no homogenization adjustment (docs/data/sources/ghcnm.md).

gistemp_anom.name_en: Surface temperature anomaly, land and ocean (GISTEMP v4, 1200 km smoothing)
gistemp_anom.data_kind_note: NASA GISTEMP v4: a gridded analysis of station (NOAA GHCN v4, homogenized) and ship/buoy (NOAA ERSST v5) observations with spatial interpolation (smoothing radius 1200 km, or 250 km for the land-only product, which uses stations only); in situ observations, but not a single-point measurement (docs/data/sources/gistemp.md).

gldas_tair.data_kind_note: GLDAS_NOAH025_M.2.1 Tair_f_inst: a forcing input of the GLDAS model run, taken from the NOAA GDAS atmospheric analysis; not an output of the land-surface model and not a station measurement (docs/data/gldas-tair-check.md).

power_t2m.data_kind_note: NASA POWER, which serves MERRA-2 reanalysis fields.
